official_sources.title: Department of Home Affairs, immigration and citizenship

notes: Paying for a visa sponsorship or a job offer is not allowed in Australia's sponsored visa programmes.

visa_routes.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)
visa_routes.summary: Points-tested permanent visa. You need an occupation on the relevant list, a positive skills assessment, competent English and an invitation through SkillSelect.

steps.title: Skills assessment
steps.description: From the assessing authority for your occupation.

steps.title: English test
steps.description: Meet at least competent English; higher scores give more points.

steps.title: Expression of interest in SkillSelect
steps.description: Submit an EOI and wait for an invitation.

steps.title: Apply after invitation
steps.description: Lodge the visa application within the deadline.

requirements.title: Under 45 when invited
requirements.description: You must be under 45 at the time of invitation.

requirements.title: At least competent English
requirements.description: Check the current accepted tests and scores on the Home Affairs page before booking.

requirements.title: Positive skills assessment
requirements.description: From the assessing authority for your nominated occupation.

visa_routes.name: Student visa (subclass 500)
visa_routes.summary: For full-time study at a registered course; needs a confirmation of enrolment, English, funds and health insurance.

steps.title: Confirmation of enrolment
steps.description: From your education provider.

steps.title: Health insurance and funds
steps.description: Arrange the required health cover and show enough money.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.description: Through ImmiAccount.

documents: Proof of funds and health cover

requirements.title: English test, as required
requirements.description: Check the current accepted tests and scores on the Home Affairs page.

notes: Legitimate Canadian employers and immigration programmes do not ask you to pay for a job offer. Fees for "guaranteed" job offers are a known scam.

visa_routes.name: Express Entry, Federal Skilled Worker
visa_routes.summary: Permanent residence for skilled workers, ranked by points. You need an approved language test, education, skilled work experience and, without a job offer, proof of funds.

steps.title: Take an approved language test
steps.description: IELTS General Training, CELPIP-General, PTE Core, or a French test. Results must be recent.

steps.title: Get an educational credential assessment
steps.description: Foreign degrees need an assessment from a designated organisation.

steps.title: Create an Express Entry profile
steps.description: You get a points score and enter the pool.

steps.title: Invitation to apply
steps.description: If your score is high enough in a draw, you are invited to apply for permanent residence.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.description: Upload documents, medical exam and police certificates within the deadline.

documents: Proof of funds, unless you have a valid job offer
Police certificates and medical exam, when asked

requirements.title: Language at CLB 7 in all four abilities
requirements.description: For IELTS General Training that is 6.0 in each of listening, reading, writing and speaking; for CELPIP-General, 7 in each.

requirements.title: At least 1 year of skilled work experience
requirements.description: Continuous paid skilled work in the last 10 years.

requirements.title: Completed secondary or post-secondary education
requirements.description: Foreign education needs an educational credential assessment.

requirements.title: Proof of settlement funds
requirements.description: Needed unless you have a valid job offer; the amount depends on family size and is updated regularly.

visa_routes.name: Study permit
visa_routes.summary: For students accepted by a designated learning institution. Most applicants also need a provincial attestation letter and proof of funds.

steps.title: Get an acceptance letter
steps.description: From a designated learning institution.

steps.title: Get a provincial or territorial attestation letter
steps.description: Most study permit applicants need one; check if you are exempt.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.description: With proof of funds, biometrics and any medical exam asked for.

requirements.title: English or French test, as your institution requires
requirements.description: The minimum score is set by your institution and programme.

notes: Specified Skilled Workers are covered by Japanese labour law and should be paid at least what a Japanese worker would get for the same job. Confirm on the official portal.

visa_routes.name: Specified Skilled Worker (i)
visa_routes.summary: For workers in listed sectors who pass a sector skills test and a Japanese language test.

steps.title: Pick a listed sector
steps.description: Check that your job is in one of the sectors open to Specified Skilled Workers.

steps.title: Pass the sector skills test
steps.description: Each sector has its own skills test.

steps.title: Pass a Japanese language test
steps.description: JFT-Basic at A2, or JLPT N4 or higher.

steps.title: Employment contract with a Japanese employer
steps.description: The employer signs a contract and applies for your Certificate of Eligibility.

steps.title: Visa application
steps.description: Apply for the visa at the Japanese embassy with the Certificate of Eligibility.

requirements.title: Age 18 or older
requirements.description: Applicants must be at least 18.

requirements.title: Japanese language test
requirements.description: JFT-Basic at A2, or JLPT N4 or higher.

requirements.title: Sector skills test
requirements.description: Pass the skills test for your sector.
